vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: kg-note-method-obsidian
Version: 2.13.0

The skill bundle provides a structured framework for organizing Obsidian notes using a Knowledge Graph (KG) methodology. It defines specific note types (Concept, Object, Skill, Relation) and enforces strict workflows for file reading, searching, and linking to maintain vault integrity. While the instructions in SKILL.md are highly prescriptive for the AI agent and reference a specific local directory (D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost), the logic is entirely consistent with note organization and lacks any indicators of malicious intent, such as data exfiltration, unauthorized network calls, or hidden command execution.

llm.summary: This instruction-only Obsidian organizer is coherent and disclosed, but users should expect it to read/search the vault and make persistent note edits.

dimensions.detail: The requested read, search, create, modify, and delete actions match the stated purpose of reorganizing an Obsidian knowledge-graph vault, but they can change user notes.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill sets a mandatory startup workflow for Obsidian note operations, which is purpose-aligned but broadly worded for matching vault paths or note-organization tasks.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec, code files, binaries, environment variables, credentials, network endpoints, or static-scan findings are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is scoped to Obsidian note work and a named vault path, but it instructs the agent to search related notes in the vault.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: There is no background persistence or elevated privilege request, but the intended workflow persists changes by creating, modifying, renaming, or deleting note content/files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears benign and purpose-aligned for organizing an Obsidian KG-style vault. Before installing, make sure you want the agent to read/search related notes and persistently modify the vault; keep backups and request confirmation before deletions or large restructuring.

evidence.explanation: The skill makes its own startup command mandatory for a broad class of Obsidian-note tasks, which can steer the agent's workflow even though it is related to the skill's purpose.
evidence.snippet: 判断标准：路径含 `D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost` 或任务涉及笔记整理 → 必须先执行启动命令。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Install only if you want this KG note method to govern those vault operations; override it for unrelated or read-only note tasks.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: When working with matching Obsidian notes, the agent may treat this skill's workflow as mandatory before touching files.

evidence.explanation: The intended workflow includes persistent file creation, modification, and deletion in the Obsidian vault. This is disclosed and aligned with note organization, but it can affect user data.
evidence.snippet: 操作完成后在回复中列出所有更改：新建/修改/删除的文件清单。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use with a backed-up vault and ask the agent to show a proposed diff or get confirmation before deletions, renames, or broad relationship creation.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may reorganize notes, create relationship notes, remove direct links, and delete duplicate or invalid material.

evidence.explanation: The skill directs the agent to search and read related local notes as context. This is expected for an Obsidian organizer, but vault notes may contain private information.
evidence.snippet: `search_files` 搜库中与当前操作笔记有关联的其他笔记。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Limit use to vaults and notes you are comfortable sharing with the agent, and avoid running it across sensitive unrelated notes.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private note contents may be loaded into the agent's context while it organizes related files.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill gives broad but disclosed note-management instructions, including mandatory startup and persistent note edits/deletions.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account access, elevated privileges, or delegated external authority are requested.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The agent is instructed to read and search local Obsidian notes, which is expected for the purpose but may expose private note content to the agent context.
